situation: I work at a small camera shop. A customer wants the $1,200 telephoto lens to shoot his kid's school soccer games, but the $450 one would do fine.
reply: For school soccer from the sideline, the 70 to 300 at $450 will honestly do the job; it's sharp and light enough to carry all game. The $1,200 one earns its price in low light, so if you'll be shooting a lot of indoor or evening games, that's when it's worth it. Either one will get you great shots.
note: The honest downsell is what makes your next recommendation believable.

situation: I'm the receptionist at a hair salon. A client booked a cut and mentioned she wants to go lighter for her sister's wedding next month. She's never had colour.
reply: You're booked with Ines for a cut on Saturday at 11. Since you mentioned going lighter for the wedding, she could add face-framing highlights in the same visit: it's $95 more and adds about an hour. Totally fine to just do the cut and decide on colour another time.
note: One suggestion tied to what she said, with the cost and time stated plainly.

situation: 小さなお米屋をやっています。常連の田中さんが3ヶ月前に10kg買っていったので、そろそろかなと思ってLINEしたい。今年の新米も入りました。
reply: 田中さん、こんにちは。前回10kgお求めいただいてから3ヶ月ほど経ったので、そろそろかなと思ってご連絡しました。今年の新米のコシヒカリが入っています。前回と同じお米でも新米でも、ご希望があればお届けします。まだ残っていたら、気にせずスルーしてくださいね。
note: A reminder with a real reason beats a discount; the easy no keeps the next order warm.

situation: 我是做小程序的外包，帮一家社区烘焙店做的点单小程序刚上线两周，老板说单量涨了不少。我觉得下一步做会员积分对她很有用，但不想像在推销。
reply: 张姐，看到这两周线上单量涨了四成，真替你高兴。你之前提过老客很多，下一步比较自然的是加一个会员积分，复购一般靠这个。这块开发大概6800元，两周能上线。现在不急，你觉得有需要我再出个方案，不做也完全没问题。
note: 在对方体验好的时候提，只提一个，说清价格和工期，最后给一个轻松的不。

situation: I'm a wedding photographer. A couple booked my 6-hour package ($2,800) and I suggested adding a second shooter for $600 since they have 180 guests. The bride replied: 'We told you our budget is tight, can you please stop upselling us.'
reply: Fair enough, that came across as a sell rather than a suggestion, and that wasn't the idea. You're all set with the 6-hour package for Saturday 17 October, and I'll make sure the ceremony and speeches are covered from the best angles. I'll send the draft shot list by Friday.
note: After a no that stings, own it in one line and confirm the original booking; never raise the second shooter again unless they ask.

situation: I'm an account manager at a small scheduling software company. A dental practice, Bright Smile Dental, has paid our monthly plan ($89) for 14 months and renews Oct 12. Annual is $890. Their office manager Tanya has never asked about it.
reply: Hi Tanya, a quick one before your renewal on October 12. You've been with us 14 months on the monthly plan, so it looks like the tool is here to stay. On the annual plan you'd pay $890 for the year instead of $1,068, which saves $178. The trade-off is paying it all up front, and it's only refundable in the first 30 days. If monthly suits your cash flow better, nothing changes and there's no need to reply.
note: B2B renewal: the reason is their own 14-month history, the saving and the catch are both in numbers, and silence is a valid answer.

situation: I run a cleaning service. Last week Nora booked a standard clean and said no when I mentioned the $40 oven add-on. Now she's texted 'how much was the oven thing again? could you add it Thursday?'
reply: Of course. The oven clean is $40 on top of your $110 standard clean and adds about 45 minutes. I'll put it on Thursday 1 October at 10am, $150 in total. Reply yes and it's booked.
note: Answer as if it's the first time she's asked: no 'as I mentioned', and no extra pitch while she's saying yes.

situation: Tenho uma oficina de bicicletas em Curitiba. O Fernando perguntou qual a diferença entre a revisão básica (R$ 120) e a completa (R$ 280). Ele usa a bike só para ir ao trabalho, 5 km por dia, e ela tem um ano.
reply: Oi, Fernando! A completa custa R$ 160 a mais, e a diferença real é que desmontamos e engraxamos os rolamentos do movimento central e das rodas. Para uma bike de um ano rodando 5 km por dia, a básica resolve bem: freios, marchas, lubrificação e calibragem. A completa começa a valer a pena no segundo ou terceiro ano, ou se aparecer algum barulho. Quer que eu agende a básica para sábado, dia 3, de manhã?
note: Quando perguntam a diferença: uma diferença concreta e a verdade sobre quando vale a pena. O downsell honesto é o que dá credibilidade à próxima recomendação.

situation: 我是健身房私教，学员小陈买的20节课还剩2节。两个月里他深蹲从40公斤练到了70公斤，腰也不疼了。我想提一下续课，但不想像在推销。
reply: 小陈，还剩两节课了。这两个月你深蹲从40公斤到了70公斤，腰也不疼了，进步真的很明显。如果接下来想继续练增肌，比较合适的是再买20节的课包，一共5400元，每节比单买便宜30元。说实话，现在动作你都掌握了，自己按计划练也完全可以，我可以把接下来两个月的计划写好发你。你考虑看看，不续也没关系。
note: 在效果最好的时候提，只提一个选项，价格说清楚，同时给出不花钱的选择；诚实的替代方案才让建议可信。

situation: I'm a heating engineer. Mr. Okafor had his boiler serviced last Oct 14 and hasn't booked this year's. The boiler is 11 years old. I want to text a reminder that doesn't read like a sales pitch.
reply: Hi Mr. Okafor, it's Dan from Warmway Heating. Your boiler's yearly service comes up around Oct 14, and it's worth doing before the first cold week, since that's when an 11-year-old boiler is most likely to play up. Same $95 as last year. I have Thursday Oct 8 at 9am or Tuesday Oct 13 at 2pm; if you'd rather leave it for now, no problem at all.
note: A repeat-service nudge works on a real reason and real dates, not a discount, and the easy no stays in.

situation: I own a small garage. Mrs. Patel brought her 2019 Corolla in for an oil change. Her front brake pads are at 4mm, so they'll need doing in the next few months, not today. Fitted pads are $180. I want to mention it without scaring her into it.
reply: Hi Mrs. Patel, your Corolla's ready: oil and filter changed, $79 as quoted. One thing we noticed: the front brake pads are at 4mm, which is fine for now, but they'll need replacing in the next three to four months depending on how much you drive. It's $180 fitted, and we can do it today or at your next visit, whichever suits you. I just didn't want it to come as a surprise.
note: Honest timing is the whole point: say what's safe now and when it won't be, and never turn 'soon' into 'today'.

situation: 我在大理开民宿。客人刘先生订了10月16日到18日两晚标准间，每晚380元，备注说是结婚十周年。那两晚海景房还空着，每晚580元。想入住前在微信上提一下，不想像推销。
reply: 刘先生您好，我是半山民宿的老周，您10月16日到18日两晚的标准间已经确认好了。看到备注说是结婚十周年，先恭喜二位！那两晚我们的海景房还空着，躺在床上就能看到洱海日出，每晚580元，比标准间多200元。标准间采光好也安静，住着完全舒服。想换的话回我一句就行，不换也没关系，到时候见。
note: 入住前提一次、只提一个选项，理由来自客人自己的备注，差价说清楚，并诚实说明原房间也很好。

situation: Ich gebe Mathe-Nachhilfe. Mein Schüler Jonas, 10. Klasse, kommt einmal pro Woche für 60 Minuten, 35 Euro. Die Abschlussprüfung ist Ende Mai und bei Funktionen hakt es noch deutlich. Ich möchte seiner Mutter, Frau Brandt, eine zweite Stunde pro Woche vorschlagen, ohne dass es nach Geschäftemacherei klingt.
reply: Liebe Frau Brandt, Jonas ist seit September gut dabei, bei den Gleichungen sieht man den Fortschritt deutlich. Bei den Funktionen braucht er noch mehr Übung, und die kommen in der Abschlussprüfung erfahrungsgemäß oft dran. Mein Vorschlag wäre deshalb, ab Januar bis zur Prüfung eine zweite Stunde pro Woche dazuzunehmen, also 70 statt 35 Euro wöchentlich. Ehrlich gesagt geht es auch mit einer Stunde, wenn er die Übungsblätter, die ich ihm mitgebe, zu Hause durcharbeitet. Sagen Sie einfach, was für Sie besser passt, beides ist völlig in Ordnung.
note: Ein Vorschlag mit echtem Grund, klaren Kosten und einer kostenlosen Alternative, damit ein Nein sich nicht wie Sparen am Kind anfühlt.
